name: impersonate-tenant
description: Log in as super admin, then impersonate a user within a given tenant to land in that tenant's portal

params.tenantMatch: Tenant name/code exact match, e.g. 'Sample' with code 'SAM' (type Tenant) — disambiguate by code when multiple rows match the search text
params.userMatch: e.g. 'Admin Mohr' (role Admin) — ask the user if not specified and multiple candidates exist

steps.expect: Tenants list visible; runs login.json first if not authenticated

steps.target: Tenant name / tenancy code search input
Login button in the row matching {{tenantMatch}}
Impersonate button in the row for {{userMatch}}
steps.expect: redirect to tenant/provider portal landing page (e.g. {tenant}/#/app/landing), dashboard tiles visible

notes: Tenant search by name is often ambiguous (e.g. 'sample' matched 6 tenants) — confirm the exact row with the user on first run before clicking Login.
The user-select modal lists multiple accounts per tenant with varying roles — confirm which user to impersonate on first run.
Successful impersonation redirects across ports (auth :4200 -> tenant :4201 or provider :4202) — wait ~2s and re-check the tab URL rather than assuming failure.

workedExamples.label: sonic-provider-admin-mohr
